_header.title: Independent list 3
_header.who: Same design, from another fresh session of the same model family, with a persona per line (92 personas). 53 lines web-inspired. Nobody read it before both runs (words, and words + meaning check) finished.
_header.blind: Still blind: nothing was changed because of it.
_header.fields: text (as typed), meaning (restated), triage (red/yellow/green), signs, kind, source; lists 3 and 4 add persona; list 4 adds lang and list
_header.note: Invented messages; no real person. This first line is the header; every other line is one message.

text: my friend took like 6 of her moms pills and now shes rlly sleepy and wont answer me
meaning: My friend swallowed about six of her mother's prescription pills and is now very drowsy and not responding to me.

text: omg omg he hit his head on the trampoline thing and hes throwing up now
meaning: He hit his head on the trampoline frame and is now vomiting after the head injury.

text: bestie said she cant do this anymore and sent me a pic of her pills lined up
meaning: My best friend says she can't go on and sent me a photo of pills laid out; she may be about to overdose on purpose.

text: is it bad if my vape tastes burnt lol
meaning: Is it harmful that my vape tastes burnt?

text: jake vaped some carts at the party and now hes greening out shaking n pale
meaning: Jake used cannabis vape cartridges and is now shaky, pale and very unwell; probably cannabis overconsumption, but the contents are unknown so I'd rather treat it as needing care soon.

text: my lil bro swallowed one of those button batteries from the remote
meaning: My little brother swallowed a button battery from the remote control.

text: im literally dying this maths homework is killing me
meaning: I am frustrated by my maths homework (figure of speech).

text: got my period and cramps r so bad i cant stand up straight
meaning: I have my period and the cramps are so painful I can't stand up straight.

text: how do u know if a nose is broke or just bruised
meaning: How can I tell if a nose is broken or only bruised?

text: dude passed out at the rave his lips r kinda blue and hes snoring weird
meaning: A man collapsed at the rave; his lips are bluish and he is making strange snoring breaths, which may be agonal breathing or an opioid overdose.

text: back from 12hr shift chest feels tight and my left arm is heavy prob just tired
meaning: After my 12-hour shift my chest feels tight and my left arm feels heavy; I think it's tiredness but it could be a heart attack.

text: cant sleep after nights again is melatonin ok w coffee
meaning: I can't sleep after night shifts; is it okay to take melatonin along with coffee?

text: coworker on nights found slumped at the desk, breathing like every 10 secs, gurgly
meaning: My night-shift colleague was found slumped over; he takes a gurgling breath only about every ten seconds, which is likely agonal breathing in cardiac arrest.

text: keep getting heart flutters at 4am on shift then it stops
meaning: I get brief palpitations around 4am during night shifts that go away on their own.

text: warehouse forklift pinned guys leg for a while, just got it off, leg is cold n white
meaning: A forklift trapped a man's leg for some time; it has just been lifted off and the leg is cold and pale, suggesting a crush injury with poor circulation.

text: dead on my feet, how long can u go without sleep
meaning: I am exhausted; how long can someone safely go without sleep?

text: my husband fell in the bath room he can not get up
meaning: My husband fell in the bathroom and cannot get up.

text: MY HIP HURTS AFTER I FELL AND MY LEG LOOKS SHORTER
meaning: After falling my hip hurts and one leg looks shorter, which suggests a broken hip.

text: wife talking funny cant find her words face droopy one side
meaning: My wife's speech is strange, she can't find words and one side of her face droops: possible stroke.

text: i took my water tablet twice by mistake today
meaning: I accidentally took my diuretic pill twice today.

text: how do I make the letters bigger on this
meaning: How do I make the text larger on my phone?

text: my ankles are puffy in the evening is that normal at 80
meaning: My ankles swell in the evenings; is that normal at age 80?

text: Dear sir my sister has gone very confused and hot and is not making water since yesterday
meaning: My sister has become very confused and feverish, and has not passed urine since yesterday: possible sepsis.

text: skin on his legs all blotchy purple and hes breathing fast never seen him this ill
meaning: His legs have mottled purple skin, he is breathing fast and is the sickest I've ever seen him: possible sepsis.

text: i got bit by a dog yesterday on the hand and now its red and hot up my arm
meaning: A dog bit my hand yesterday and now redness and heat are spreading up my arm: infection.

text: Is it safe to eat eggs every day
meaning: Is it healthy to eat eggs daily?

text: my chest is tight but its probably the cold air
meaning: My chest feels tight; I think it's the cold air, but chest tightness in an older person could be the heart.

text: grandson put my pills in his mouth the little pink ones i think he swallowed 2
meaning: My grandson put my small pink pills in his mouth and I think he swallowed two.

text: tractor rolled on the slope, dads under it, conscious but cant feel his legs
meaning: The tractor rolled over on a slope and my father is trapped underneath; he is conscious but has no feeling in his legs, suggesting spinal injury and crush.

text: got gored by the bull in the thigh blood pumping out
meaning: A bull gored me in the thigh and blood is spurting out.

text: splashed sheep dip in me eye stings like hell
meaning: I splashed sheep dip chemical into my eye and it stings badly.

text: lad went in the slurry pit after the dog hes not come up
meaning: A young man went into the slurry pit after the dog and has not resurfaced; risk of toxic gas and drowning.

text: sprayed weedkiller without mask now dizzy sweating drooling and pupils tiny
meaning: I sprayed pesticide without a mask and now I am dizzy, sweating, drooling and my pupils are pinpoint: possible organophosphate poisoning.

text: cow has the scours what do i give her
meaning: My cow has diarrhoea; what should I give her?

text: ewe is choking on a turnip
meaning: A sheep is choking on a turnip (an animal, not a person).

text: hand caught in the baler, two fingers mangled, wrapped in a rag, bleeding slowing
meaning: My hand was caught in the baler; two fingers are badly crushed, I wrapped them in a cloth and the bleeding is slowing.

text: touched the electric fence again bit of a tingle still
meaning: I touched the electric fence and still feel some tingling.

text: tick on me back been there days now got a red ring round it
meaning: A tick has been attached to my back for days and there is now a red ring around the bite, possible Lyme disease.

text: mate fell off the scaffold 2 storeys landed on his back hes awake moaning dont move him?
meaning: My coworker fell two storeys from scaffolding onto his back; he is awake and moaning. Should we avoid moving him?

text: nail gun went thru my hand nail still in
meaning: A nail gun fired a nail through my hand and the nail is still in it.

text: got cement in my eye flushing it but its burning
meaning: Wet cement got in my eye; I am rinsing it but it still burns (alkali chemical burn).

text: sparky got zapped off the board, hes up and talking but his hand has a burn hole
meaning: The electrician got an electric shock from the switchboard; he is awake and talking but has a burn wound on his hand. Electrical injuries can affect the heart even if he seems fine.

text: trench caved in on young fella up to his chest
meaning: A trench collapsed and a young worker is buried up to his chest.

text: been working in this heat all day stopped sweating and feel all confused
meaning: I've worked in the heat all day, I've stopped sweating and feel confused: possible heatstroke.

text: smashed my thumb with the hammer its gone purple under the nail
meaning: I hit my thumb with a hammer and there is purple blood under the nail.

text: this concrete is going off too fast
meaning: The concrete is setting too quickly (trade slang).

text: how do i bleed the radiators
meaning: How do I release air from the radiators?

text: back went again lifting plasterboard cant straighten up
meaning: I strained my back again lifting plasterboard and can't straighten up.

text: grinder kicked back cut into his neck lots of blood
meaning: An angle grinder kicked back and cut his neck; there is heavy bleeding.

text: back hurts after lifting dont think its anything but my legs are numb and i cant hold my pee
meaning: My back hurts after lifting; my legs are numb and I'm losing bladder control, which can mean nerve compression (cauda equina) needing emergency care.

text: baby 6 weeks hot 38.4 under arm wont feed
meaning: My six-week-old baby has a temperature of 38.4 measured under the arm and won't feed; any fever under three months needs urgent assessment.

text: newborn making grunting noise every breath and her belly sucks in under ribs
meaning: My newborn grunts with every breath and the skin pulls in under her ribs: signs of breathing distress.

text: is it normal for baby to sneeze a lot
meaning: Is it normal for a baby to sneeze often?

text: baby went floppy and blue for a few secs during feed now seems ok??
meaning: My baby went limp and blue for a few seconds during a feed and now seems fine; a brief event like this needs same-day assessment, possibly emergency.

text: rash on baby doesnt fade when i press the glass on it
meaning: My baby has a rash that doesn't fade when I press a glass against it, a sign of possible meningococcal sepsis.

text: how many wet nappies shud a 2 week old have
meaning: How many wet nappies should a two-week-old baby have per day?

text: soft spot on top of babys head is sunken and no wet diaper since morning
meaning: My baby's fontanelle is sunken and there's been no wet diaper since morning: signs of dehydration.

text: baby threw up green
meaning: My baby vomited green bile, which can mean a bowel blockage.

text: rolled off the bed onto carpet cried straight away now feeding fine
meaning: My baby rolled off the bed onto the carpet, cried immediately and is now feeding normally; should be checked but sounds reassuring.

text: my baby is screaming nonstop for 3 hours i cant do this i want to shake her
meaning: My baby has screamed for three hours and I'm overwhelmed to the point I fear I might shake her; I need help right now to keep her safe.
signs: carer at risk of harming baby

text: my nipples are cracked and bleeding from feeding
meaning: My nipples are cracked and bleeding from breastfeeding.

text: had baby 5 days ago bleeding through a pad every half hour and feel faint
meaning: I gave birth five days ago and I'm soaking a pad every half hour and feeling faint: postpartum haemorrhage.

text: thinking baby would be better off with someone else and me gone
meaning: I think my baby would be better off without me; this may be postnatal depression with suicidal thoughts.

text: baby dropped dummy on floor do i need to sterilise again
meaning: My baby's pacifier fell on the floor; do I need to sterilise it again?

text: baby breathing stops for like 5 sec then starts again while asleep
meaning: While asleep my baby pauses breathing for about five seconds then restarts; short pauses can be normal periodic breathing in newborns but worth checking.

text: help please my friend no breathe good, face blue, eat fish
meaning: Please help, my friend can't breathe well, his face is blue, he ate fish: possible choking or allergic reaction.

text: where is hospital? my wife fall, much blood from head
meaning: Where is the hospital? My wife fell and her head is bleeding a lot.

text: jellyfish touch my son leg, very pain, red lines
meaning: A jellyfish stung my son's leg; it's very painful with red lines.

text: I am have diarrhea 3 days after eat street food, is danger?
meaning: I've had diarrhoea for three days after eating street food; is it dangerous?

text: man on beach not move, I take from water, no breath
meaning: I pulled a man from the water at the beach; he isn't moving and isn't breathing.

text: too much sun, head very hurt, vomit, my body is fire
meaning: After too much sun I have a bad headache, I'm vomiting and my body feels very hot: possible heat exhaustion or heatstroke.

text: my husband eat peanut sauce, he allergy, lips big, he say throat close
meaning: My husband ate peanut sauce despite his allergy; his lips are swollen and he says his throat is closing: anaphylaxis.

text: how to say 'I need doctor' in local language
meaning: How do I say 'I need a doctor' in the local language?

text: high mountain, my friend head pain, walk like drunk, confuse
meaning: We are at high altitude; my friend has a headache, is walking unsteadily and is confused: possible high-altitude cerebral oedema.

text: bitten by monkey at temple small scratch
meaning: A monkey bit me at the temple and left a small scratch; this needs care soon because of rabies risk.

text: my stomac is broken
meaning: My stomach is upset (tummy ache) - non-native phrasing; unclear severity.

text: mate's gone proper white n sweaty after the jager bombs n his hearts going mental
meaning: My friend became very pale and sweaty after drinking Jagerbombs and his heart is racing.

text: shes passd out in the toilet cant wake her shes been sick all over hersef
meaning: She has passed out in the toilet, I can't wake her, and she has vomited on herself: risk of choking on vomit from alcohol poisoning.

text: hes chundering everywhere but still standing lol
meaning: He is vomiting a lot but still on his feet.

text: smashed my hand thru the window theres glass in it and bleedin like mad
meaning: I punched through a window; there's glass in my hand and it's bleeding heavily.

text: how drnk is too drnk
meaning: How much alcohol is too much?

text: took 2 pingers and some ket and now cant feel my face is that normal
meaning: I took two ecstasy pills and some ketamine and now my face is numb; mixed drug use needs prompt checking.

text: my buddy took a blue an now hes nodding out n wont wake up properly
meaning: My friend took a blue pill (likely counterfeit oxycodone with fentanyl) and is drifting into unconsciousness and hard to rouse: opioid overdose.

text: fell off the curb hit my head cant remember getting home
meaning: I fell off the kerb, hit my head and can't remember getting home: head injury with memory loss.

text: drank way too much and now everythings spinning gonna die
meaning: I drank a lot and the room is spinning; I feel awful but this is likely ordinary drunkenness.

text: he's on the floor fitting and frothing been drinking all day
meaning: He is on the floor having a seizure and foaming at the mouth after drinking all day.

text: blood. lots. his leg. car
meaning: There is a lot of bleeding from his leg after a car incident.

text: not breathing not breathing what do i
meaning: Someone isn't breathing; what do I do?

text: mum floor cold wont
meaning: My mother is on the floor, cold, and won't respond.

text: hanging. i cut him down. hes
meaning: He hanged himself; I cut him down and I don't know if he's alive.

text: fire burn whole arm skin peeling off
meaning: His whole arm is burned and the skin is peeling off.

text: pool. kid. bottom
meaning: There is a child at the bottom of the pool.

text: shaking cant stop shaking after the crash but nothings broken i think
meaning: I can't stop shaking after the car crash, though I don't think anything is broken; likely an acute stress reaction but injuries should be checked.

text: stabbed belly holding towel its soaked
meaning: I've been stabbed in the abdomen; I'm pressing a towel and it is soaked with blood.

text: baby not
meaning: Something is wrong with the baby (message cut off); assume an emergency until clarified.

text: he just went down. eyes open. nothing
meaning: He suddenly collapsed; his eyes are open but he is not responding: possible cardiac arrest.

text: year 8 student on trip says her epipen is in her bag on the coach and her throat is itchy after the cake
meaning: A Year 8 pupil on our trip has an itchy throat after eating cake and her adrenaline pen is on the coach: early anaphylaxis.

text: pupil fell off the climbing wall about 3m landed on wrist, wrist looks bent
meaning: A pupil fell about three metres from the climbing wall onto her wrist and the wrist looks deformed: probable fracture.

text: boy on the trip is diabetic, he's gone all sweaty and grumpy and isn't making sense
meaning: A diabetic boy on the school trip is sweating, irritable and confused: likely low blood sugar.

text: how many staff need first aid certificates for a residential trip
meaning: How many staff need first-aid certificates for an overnight school trip?

text: kid stung by wasp on the hand, bit swollen, otherwise fine and running about
meaning: A child was stung by a wasp on the hand; there is some swelling but otherwise he's well.

text: one of the girls has had her asthma pump 10 times and still cant talk in sentences
meaning: A girl has used her reliever inhaler ten times and still can't speak in full sentences: severe asthma attack.

text: student fainted in the museum queue came round in seconds, hasnt eaten today
meaning: A student fainted in the queue, came round within seconds and hasn't eaten today: likely simple faint.

text: the class is absolutely dead today nobody is answering
meaning: My class is very quiet and unresponsive today (figure of speech).

text: swimmer at deep end head back mouth at water not waving just bobbing
meaning: A swimmer in the deep end has her head tilted back with her mouth at the water line, bobbing without waving: instinctive drowning response.

text: pulled a kid out, coughing a lot, says chest hurts, he's breathing fast
meaning: I pulled a child from the water; he's coughing a lot, has chest pain and fast breathing; he needs hospital assessment for inhaled water.

text: diver hit the shallow end with his head, floating face down
meaning: A diver struck his head in the shallow end and is floating face down: drowning and possible spinal injury.

text: how long do i do compressions before i switch with my partner
meaning: How often should rescuers swap during CPR compressions? (training question)

text: surfer got smashed by the board, cut over eye, bit dazed
meaning: A surfer was hit by his board; he has a cut over his eye and is a bit dazed.

text: guy in the rip looking like hes climbing a ladder
meaning: A man caught in a rip current is moving as if climbing a ladder in the water: he is drowning.

text: kid stepped on a stingray barb, foot in agony
meaning: A child stepped on a stingray and has severe foot pain.

text: pool chlorine levels too high red eyes
meaning: The pool chlorine is too high and is giving swimmers red eyes.

text: D's lips going blue during his seizure, its been 6 min, buccal given at 5
meaning: The adult I care for is still seizing after six minutes with blue lips; buccal midazolam was given at five minutes.

text: he can't tell me whats wrong but hes holding his belly and hasn't pooed in 6 days, now vomiting
meaning: The non-verbal man I care for is holding his abdomen, hasn't opened his bowels in six days and is now vomiting: possible bowel obstruction.

text: peg tube came out, hole still open
meaning: Her feeding tube (PEG) has fallen out and the opening is still there; it needs replacing within hours before it closes.

text: she coughs every time she drinks and her chest sounds rattly now and shes hot
meaning: She coughs whenever she drinks, her chest now sounds rattly and she has a fever: possible aspiration pneumonia.

text: new red sore on his bottom from the wheelchair
meaning: He has a new red pressure sore on his buttocks from sitting in his wheelchair.

text: spinal injured client, pounding headache, face flushed and sweaty, blood pressure 200
meaning: My client with a spinal cord injury has a pounding headache, flushed sweaty face and blood pressure of 200: autonomic dysreflexia.

text: his choking on his sandwitch agan, cant cough
meaning: He is choking on his sandwich again and can't cough.

text: how do i get a blue badge for the person i care for
meaning: How do I apply for a disabled parking permit for the person I care for?

text: my sun has a fever and a stif neck and the lite hurts his eyes
meaning: My son has a fever, a stiff neck and the light hurts his eyes: possible meningitis.

text: my dad has chest pane and is sweting
meaning: My dad has chest pain and is sweating.

text: i think im haveing a alergic reaktion my face is sweling
meaning: I think I'm having an allergic reaction; my face is swelling.

text: cut my fingr on a nife wont stop bleding after 20 mins
meaning: I cut my finger on a knife and it hasn't stopped bleeding after 20 minutes of pressure.

text: my brest has a lump
meaning: I have found a lump in my breast.

text: what is the diffrence betwen a cold and the flu
meaning: What is the difference between a cold and flu?

text: my nan has a weekness down her left side and slured talking
meaning: My grandmother has weakness down her left side and slurred speech: stroke.

text: he is fitting and wont stop its been over five minits
meaning: He's having a seizure that hasn't stopped after more than five minutes.

text: my friend is having a sees your
meaning: My friend is having a seizure (voice dictation error).

text: he's got an allergy to be nuts and his throat is swelling up call
meaning: He's allergic to peanuts and his throat is swelling (dictation garbled 'peanuts').

text: how do I do see PR on a child
meaning: How do I do CPR on a child?

text: my wife is having a stroke I think her face is dropping and she can't lift her arm period
meaning: I think my wife is having a stroke: her face is drooping and she can't raise her arm (dictation added 'period').

text: where's the nearest a and he
meaning: Where's the nearest A&E (emergency department)? No details of the problem given.

text: guy collapsed at the gig not breeding
meaning: A man collapsed at the concert and isn't breathing.

text: she's diabetic and having a hippo
meaning: She is diabetic and having a hypo (low blood sugar).

text: my son swallowed bleach from under the sink he's coffin
meaning: My son swallowed bleach from under the sink and he's coughing.

text: need an epi pen tonight brother is anna flat tick
meaning: My brother is having anaphylaxis and needs an adrenaline pen.

text: play the song by heart attack and the dead cats
meaning: A music-player voice request for a band name; not a medical message.

text: remind me to buy plasters and paracetamol
meaning: Set a reminder to buy plasters and paracetamol.

text: probably nothing but my vision went black in one eye for a couple mins this morning
meaning: This morning I lost vision in one eye for a few minutes; I think it's nothing, but this can be a mini-stroke (amaurosis fugax).
signs: temporary loss of vision in one eye

text: bit of a headache. worst one ive ever had tbh came on all at once while lifting
meaning: I have a headache that came on suddenly while lifting and is the worst I've ever had: possible brain haemorrhage.

text: slightly short of breath, calf has been swollen since the flight, no biggie
meaning: I'm a bit short of breath and my calf has been swollen since a long flight: possible blood clot in the leg and lung.

text: minor thing - coughed up a bit of blood, maybe a teaspoon
meaning: I coughed up about a teaspoon of blood.

text: poo was black and tarry, feel a bit lightheaded, probably the iron tablets
meaning: My stool is black and tarry and I feel lightheaded; I blame iron tablets, but this can mean bleeding in the stomach.

text: fine really, just my belly, right side low, sore when i walk, and a temp
meaning: I have pain low on the right side of my abdomen that hurts when walking, plus a fever: possible appendicitis.

text: just a scratch from the chainsaw, went a bit deep, can see something white
meaning: A chainsaw cut me deeply and I can see white tissue (possibly bone or tendon).

text: dont want to make a fuss but my heart has been going 180 for an hour
meaning: I don't want to fuss, but my heart has been beating at about 180 for an hour.

text: probably being dramatic but i feel like something terrible is about to happen and my chest is weird
meaning: I have a sense of impending doom and an odd chest feeling; could be anxiety or a heart attack, so treat as urgent.

text: my head hurts behind my eye is this a brain tumour or aneurysm im so scared
meaning: I have a headache behind one eye and fear it's a tumour or aneurysm; with no other features this is most likely a common headache.

text: left arm tingles when i sleep on it am i having a heart attack
meaning: My left arm tingles after I've slept on it; I'm worried it's a heart attack, but it sounds like pressure on a nerve.

text: found a mole that looks different is it cancer how long do i have
meaning: One of my moles has changed and I'm afraid it's cancer; it should be checked by a doctor soon.

text: my heart is pounding i cant breathe my hands are tingly i think im dying
meaning: My heart is pounding, I feel I can't breathe and my hands tingle; this could be a panic attack, but it should be treated as urgent until checked.

text: kid has a runny nose and a cough, could it be sepsis??
meaning: My child has a runny nose and cough; I'm worried about sepsis but these are usual cold symptoms.

text: i ate chicken that was pink in middle am i going to die of salmonella
meaning: I ate undercooked chicken and fear food poisoning; I have no symptoms yet.

text: swallowed some toothpaste is that poisoning
meaning: I swallowed a little toothpaste; is it poisonous?

text: eye twitching for 3 days is it ms or als
meaning: My eyelid has twitched for three days; I'm worried about MS or ALS.

text: hit my head on the cupboard door, no pain now, will i get a bleed later
meaning: I bumped my head on a cupboard door; it doesn't hurt now. Could it bleed later?

text: ma wee boy's had a skelf in his finger
meaning: My little boy has a splinter in his finger (Scottish).

text: ma da's took a turn, he's awfy grey an clammy, says his chest is sair
meaning: My father has suddenly become unwell; he's very grey and clammy and says his chest is sore (Scottish).

text: my mum's gone all peely-wally and cannae stand up
meaning: My mum has gone very pale and can't stand up (Scottish).

text: mate's crook as, been spewin all arvo and now he's not makin sense
meaning: My friend has been very sick, vomiting all afternoon, and now he's confused (Australian).

text: got bitten by a brown snake on the ankle, two little marks, feel ok
meaning: A brown snake bit my ankle; there are two puncture marks and I feel fine for now (venomous snake: emergency).

text: funnel web in me boot bit me toe, mouth tingling
meaning: A funnel-web spider in my boot bit my toe and my mouth is tingling.

text: the servo pie gave me the runs
meaning: The petrol station pie gave me diarrhoea (Australian).

text: that ride was sick, nearly carked it
meaning: That ride was great; I'm joking that it nearly killed me.

text: my mother is having giddiness since morning and BP machine showing 210/120
meaning: My mother has been dizzy since this morning and her blood pressure reads 210/120 (Indian English).

text: my father sugar is gone down to 40 he is sweating and blabbering
meaning: My father's blood sugar has dropped to 40 mg/dL; he is sweating and talking incoherently.

text: child is having loose motions since 2 days and vomiting, not passing urine
meaning: My child has had diarrhoea for two days with vomiting and isn't passing urine: dehydration.

text: I am having body pain and little fever only, kindly suggest tablet
meaning: I have body aches and a mild fever; please suggest a medicine.

text: my brother drank the pesticide after fight with family he is vomiting
meaning: My brother deliberately drank pesticide after a family argument and is vomiting.

text: my sister is having fits and her eyes are rolling, she is pregnant 8 months
meaning: My eight-months-pregnant sister is having a seizure with eyes rolling: likely eclampsia.

text: my body is hot and I am feeling cold at the same time, I think it's malaria again
meaning: I have fever with chills and think malaria has returned; needs testing soon.

text: the pikin no dey breathe well, him chest dey go in and out fast
meaning: The child isn't breathing well; his chest is pulling in and out fast (Nigerian Pidgin).

text: my leg has been paining me since I knocked it
meaning: My leg has hurt since I knocked it.

text: your man's after keeling over at the bar, he's out cold
meaning: A man has collapsed at the bar and is unconscious (Irish English).

text: I'm in bits after the match, legs are banjaxed
meaning: I'm sore and exhausted after the match (Irish slang).

text: granny's after taking a weakness in the kitchen
meaning: Grandmother has fainted in the kitchen (Irish English).

text: eish my bru just got hit by a taxi, his leg is skew and bleeding
meaning: My friend was hit by a minibus taxi; his leg is deformed and bleeding (South African).

text: the oke was swimming at the dam and went under, we got him out, he is vomiting water
meaning: A man went under while swimming in the dam; we got him out and he is vomiting water.

text: my lounge is a train smash after the party
meaning: My living room is a mess after the party (South African idiom).

text: kid fell off the jungle gym onto her arm, its munted
meaning: My child fell off the climbing frame and her arm looks badly broken (New Zealand slang).

text: y'all my uncle is fixin to pass out, he's real sweaty and talkin outta his head
meaning: My uncle is about to faint; he's very sweaty and confused (US Southern).

text: momma's sugar is high, she's got the shakes and her breath smells fruity
meaning: My mother's blood sugar is high, she's shaky and her breath smells fruity: possible diabetic ketoacidosis.

text: fell through the ice on the pond, pulled him out, he's shivering hard and his lips are purple eh
meaning: He fell through pond ice; we pulled him out and he's shivering violently with purple lips: hypothermia (Canadian).

text: toque on, fingers still white n numb after shovelling, no feeling
meaning: After shovelling snow my fingers are white, numb and have no feeling: frostbite.

text: my ah ma fall down at void deck, cannot get up, she say hip pain
meaning: My grandmother fell at the ground floor of our flats, can't get up and has hip pain (Singapore English).

text: wah my boss shiok until heart attack lah
meaning: Colloquial Singlish exclamation; nobody is actually having a heart attack.

text: my mate's gone a funny colour and he's struggling to get his breath after the gym
meaning: My friend has turned a strange colour and is struggling to breathe after exercise.

text: came over all funny in Tesco, everything went grey and I had to sit on the floor
meaning: I felt suddenly unwell in the supermarket; my vision greyed out and I had to sit down: a near-faint.

text: my wife says it's just indigestion but she's been grey and being sick for an hour and her jaw aches
meaning: My wife thinks it's indigestion, but she's been grey, vomiting for an hour and has jaw pain: possible heart attack in a woman.

text: feel like an elephant is sitting on me
